ledger_additions.item: Argument-root path resolution: filesystem path arguments resolve with ordinary operating-system path resolution in every verb — every component, the final one included; a symlink argument names what it resolves to (c4 id link identifies the referent's bytes; a directory reached through a link scans as that directory; restore reconciles the directory a symlink <dir> names and journals the origin path as given); an argument resolving to nothing — dangling links included — is an error, and a <dir> name occupied by a dangling symlink is not absent (exit 1, nothing modified); an absent <dir> is created with missing parents, platform-default metadata. Symlink-ness is recorded for entries inside scanned trees, never for the argument root: the root's kind joins its mode and mtime as provenance, not identity (scan the parent to record a symlink as a symlink). Recorded paths remain the deliberate opposite: store-side /path components and restore's materialization never follow symlinks.
